propositions: Flaky (nondeterministic) test failures are bugs to root-cause and fix, not transient faults to retry until they pass.
The /rebar-debug workflow is the prescribed method for debugging intermittent test failures to achieve deterministic RED before fixing.
Recheck comments are reserved for provably environmental faults (TLS/cert issues, runner outages, missing CI dispatch) with reasoning stated in the comment.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md §6 currently contradict each other by allowing recheck for failures that merely 'look transient/flaky' without environmental qualification.
Flaky CI pipelines slow development, waste tokens, and erode trust in CI as a regression oracle, making one-time root-cause debugging cheaper than repeated recheck cycles.
